title: Lesson 9. Unusual shops
subtitle: Необычные магазины: Mr B's, Hamleys, The Evolution Store

sections.title: 1. Mr B's Emporium of Reading Delights
sections.text: Mr B's Emporium of Reading Delights is a magical {book shop} in {Bath}, UK. It is located on {three} floors of an {18th} century house. It has a reading room {upstairs}, a {book spa}, big {armchairs} next to the fireplace and free {tea and coffee} for visitors. It was opened in {2006} and has {twice} been named the UK's best book shop.

sections.title: 2. Hamleys
sections.text: {Hamleys} in {London} is the oldest and the largest {toy shop} in the world. William Hamley opened his first shop in {1760}. The shop has {seven} floors and more than {50,000} toys, including computer games, plush toys and a large {Harry Potter} department. Around {five million} people visit it each year. There are {fifteen} other Hamleys stores in the UK and more than {90} worldwide.

sections.title: 3. The Evolution Store
sections.text: The {Evolution Store} is in {New York}, USA. It sells science and {natural history} collectables, for example a lollipop with a {scorpion} inside, a life-size {skeleton} and {meteorites}. It is a small {family business}, and most of the staff have an {art or science} background. Locals and tourists have been coming for {30 years}. It is like a {museum} you can shop in.
chain: a museum you can shop in

flashcards.q: Когда открылся Mr B's и чем знаменит?
flashcards.a: В 2006 году; дважды назван лучшим книжным магазином Великобритании.

flashcards.q: Что есть в Mr B's для посетителей?
flashcards.a: Читальный зал, book spa, большие кресла у камина, бесплатные чай и кофе.

flashcards.q: Какой магазин самый старый и самый большой в мире?
flashcards.a: Hamleys в Лондоне — магазин игрушек, основан в 1760 году.

flashcards.q: Сколько игрушек и этажей в Hamleys?

flashcards.a: Товары по науке и естественной истории: метеориты, скелеты, леденец со скорпионом.
